notes.title: 🤬🍆
notes.content:
Since a few people have found their way to this community hub, I am going to post an announcement, and hopefully answer a few questions. 🤓🥳

This game is still very early stage, any progress will be announced here,
or on store.steampowered.com/developer/realbutcha 😴😴

A few people have already been given beta keys, thanks for the help guys. 😍😘🥰

The amount of beta keys that will be given out will be very limited until there is a little more to show. 😫😩

This is just a spare time project for me, so there will be no ETAs or deadlines. I will work on this and push updates when I have time for it. 😎😝

There will most likely NOT be any public release within the next year. 😢😠😩😭
Thanks for understanding. ːemofdrː

The best to all of you out there ːsteamyːːsteamyː
Thanks for reading. 👋👋

If anyone has any further questions about this game, feel free to join the Group Chat. 💬


tl;dr Early stage game in the making, by yours truly. 🤬🍆
